instructions: Install the Basic Blocs integration used by the composable account form controls.
Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Create a dedicated bearer token and install it in both the CMS secret store and the Supabase function secrets.
Install the user personal information source with the deployed function URL.
checks: The CMS only stores the source configuration and private API key reference.
Each self-service request forwards x-user-id from the authenticated CMS subject.
Backoffice create requests keep x-user-id as the actor and pass the target user as a request param.
Admin dashboard personal information reads must stay behind CMS gateway permissions.
Avatar files stay in the private connector bucket and are served only through the CMS source proxy.
The connector deployer owns Supabase project credentials; the CMS source only stores its generated API key reference.
resources: Private CMS user personal information API key
Private user_account schema, avatar bucket, and Edge Function
review: Keep the user_account schema private to anon and authenticated roles.
Use x-user-id only when it has been computed by the CMS, never from browser input.
Do not expose Supabase service-role or secret keys to browser code.
syncNote: This integration creates a stateless CMS source. Supabase owns minimal personal information rows.
